source.description:
Producer finding from xtrm-oentn (KAN-128) reap validation.

Each worktree grows its own ~129 MB .gitnexus index. During the 2026-08-04 capacity P0, 102 abandoned worktrees held 11.8 GB of .gitnexus alone. xtrm does not create them (worktree creation touches .beads only — cli/src/utils/worktree-session.ts:1767-1779); GitNexus does, on first analyze inside the worktree.

xt worktree reap now treats .gitnexus as a regenerable artifact and reclaims it, but that is symptom management: per capacity-reclaim rule 3, reclaim without a source fix is theatre, and regenerating a full index per worktree wastes CPU as well as disk.

ASK: evaluate pointing GitNexus at a shared parent-repo index (or a content-addressed cache keyed on the common git dir) so linked worktrees reuse one index.

REFERENCE: xtrm-oentn scope item 6; incident bead mercury-market-data-9kjj4.
